a1.say: Let's build Calling Services in Parallel.

a1.cap: A dashboard needs a user's profile (300 ms) and recommendations (500 ms) from two services. Fetch both concurrently so the total is about 500 ms, with a 2-second overall timeout.

lines: A dashboard needs a user's profile (300 ms) and recommendations (500 ms) from two services. Fetch both concurrently so the total is about 500 ms, with a 2-second overall timeout.

a1.cap: Start both calls with supplyAsync on a virtual-thread executor, then combine them with thenCombine once both finish. orTimeout fails the whole request if it takes too long.
a1.say: Start both calls with supply Async on a virtual-thread executor, then combine them with then Combine once both finish. or Timeout fails the whole request if it takes too long.

a1.cap: Virtual threads (Java 21) let blocking HTTP calls scale without a big thread pool; Spring Boot can also enable them globally with spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true.
a1.say: Virtual threads (Java 21) let blocking HTTP calls scale without a big thread pool; Spring Boot can also enable them globally with spring.threads.virtual.enabled equals true.

a1.cap: A virtual thread per task: cheap, so blocking calls don't exhaust a pool.
Start the profile call without waiting for it.
Start the recommendations call at the same time.
thenCombine waits for both and builds the Dashboard, so the total is the slower call, not the sum.
a1.say: then Combine waits for both and builds the Dashboard, so the total is the slower call, not the sum.
